text: Figure 6.1: Modeling of SoftwareClusterDesign [TPS_MANI_01113]{DRAFT} Semantics of SoftwareClusterDesign.diagnosticAddress⌈The existence of the attribute SoftwareClusterDesign.diagnosticAddress can be used to express information about the distribution of diagnostic addresses even in a very early stage of development, i.e. this is typically done by an OEM. This includes the ability to specify multiple (i.e. several functional plus one physical) diagnostic addresses, thus the multiplicity of diagnosticAddress is set to 0..*.⌋(RS_MANI_00035)
